findings.value: A Grade II-listed building in Commercial Road, E1, that opened as a cinema in 1933, later used as an opera school and bingo hall, and now a concert and events venue with club nights.

evidence.quote: This characterful Grade II-listed building opened in 1933
It spent time as an opera school and a bingo hall

findings.value: Time Out lists a mix of gigs, club nights, immersive cinema and fights among what the venue hosts.

evidence.quote: including MMA fights, immersive cinema, club nights and a huge range of live music concerts

findings.value: The venue's own history page says it has been a flagship venue for LGBTQ+ led events since 2019, and aims to be welcoming to everyone.

evidence.quote: In 2019 Troxy cemented its reputation as one of the flagship venues for LGBTQ+ led events.
Troxy worked hard to create a respectful and welcoming environment for everyone

notes: Time Out page (dated 2023-03-10) and the venue's history page read today. No closing news found in one WebSearch. The Time Out page's keywords include 'Temporarily closed', but that page is from 2023 and the venue's own history page describes current events, so it is not used for status. A Quietus article dated 24 June 2025 reports a refurbishment (about GBP 1.5 million) with Broadwick Group; it is over six months old, so it is not news here, and the venue is said to keep its own brand and team.
